verdict.rationale: Manufact documents hosting, deploying, testing and observing your own MCP servers, and connecting existing ones by URL. Nothing in the evidence shows a deep catalog of hundreds to thousands of third-party app or API integrations reachable through the platform. The mcp-catalog mention covers browsing public publish-checklist scores, not a usable integration catalog, and deploy templates are not third-party integrations.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reach a deep catalog of third-party apps and APIs (hundreds to thousands of integrations) through the platform
